metadata.description: Modular expertise for an agent: writing, documents, engineering, security, research, career, and opportunity work. Each domain installs on its own.

plugins.name: craft-writing
plugins.description: Creative writing: novels, genres, poetry and editing. 42 skills plus the two cross-domain skills, governed by writing-constitution.

plugins.name: craft-documents
plugins.description: Professional documents delivered to a reader: technical writing, user docs, reports, letters, and PDF production. 7 skills plus the cross-domain pair.

plugins.name: craft-engineering
plugins.description: Software engineering and delivery: dev, delivery and operations skills plus 16 role agents. Stack and platform agnostic; reads the project it is given.

plugins.name: craft-security
plugins.description: Defensive security and authorized assurance: threat modeling, security architecture, auth, dependency and header hardening, vulnerability assessment, and gated pentesting.

plugins.name: craft-research
plugins.description: General-purpose research for a decision: framing, source gathering, verification, competitive analysis, and conclusion-first synthesis.

plugins.name: craft-career
plugins.description: Job search and applications: honest profile, real-source job search, CV and cover letter, company research and interview preparation. Never invents a listing.

plugins.name: craft-opportunity
plugins.description: Discovering and evaluating opportunities: ideation and idea evaluation, hackathon discovery, strategy and pitching, client and market research.
